summary: All 13 design decisions and the 6 core invariants are satisfied, verified against the diff (main...HEAD, 3 commits) and by building the worktree. (1) D1 — setMagicWord() is now a pure local store with zero Drive ops; the old setMagicWordAndRepack/_rollbackMagicWord and the sourceId==null->backup(force:true) destructive branch are deleted; the UI shows the persistent backupSetWordNextBackupHint status and no longer sets _hasRemoteBackup/_lastBackupTime; a test proves uploadCount==0 and the seeded cloud file is left untouched. (2) D6/D8/D13 — backup() has a contacts-only empty guard placed after the conflict check and before any upload/markBackedUp; force:true cannot bypass it (dedicated test); allowEmpty:true is the only escape hatch. The Back Up Now button is disabled when _hasLocalContacts is false with steer hints, while Set/Change Magic Word stays enabled. (3) restore() never writes cloud, gained overrideMagicWord (used for decrypt only, never persisted — test confirms getMagicWord() stays null); the UI prompts in 3 distinct states via hadLocalWord (no-word vs wrong-word body), does NOT auto-store before retry, and asks magicWordRemember* only after a successful restore; backupRestoreConfirmBody reworded to state it OVERWRITES local data and a D12 reverse-staleness confirm fires when cloud is older than local. (4) D11 — a pre-backup downgrade confirm (backupDowngrade*) fires when the cloud file is magicword-protected but no local word is set, via the read-only cloudIsMagicWordProtected() helper (fail-open, header-only, no decrypt/write). (5) D5 — magicWordSaved reworded away from 'uploaded to Google Drive' and backupRestoreConfirmBody reworded in all 5 locales (en/zh_TW/zh/ja/ko) with real translations; obsolete magicWordSavedRepacking/magicWordRepackFailed removed; all new keys present with intact {cloudTime}/{localTime} placeholders. (6) reminder logic untouched — no diff to backup_reminder_service.dart or main_screen.dart; app_drawer logout warning left as-is. Verification in the worktree: `fvm flutter analyze` = documented 5-issue baseline only (2 firebase_options + 3 zip_import_service_test), no new issues; `fvm flutter test test/unit` = all 132 tests pass (including the new setMagicWord-no-drive-op, empty-guard default+force, allowEmpty, restore-override success/wrong, cloudBackupModifiedTime, cloudIsMagicWordProtected magicword/uid/none tests). drive_migration_test seeds one contact so the new empty guard doesn't abort the migrate path (intent unchanged). No references to the removed symbols remain anywhere in the worktree's lib/ or test/. No blocking or minor findings.
